new_nodes.content: Exterior open spaces / setbacks, coverage, floor area ratio, numbers of floors and heights: Under Section 76M of the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961 and Revised Master Plan 2015 Volume III Zoning Regulations (G.O. No. UDD 540 BEM AA SE 2004, effective 25-06-2007), the setbacks required on all sides of buildings up to 11.5 m height (plots up to 4000 sq.m) and high-rise buildings above 11.5 m height are governed by Chapter 3, Regulation 3.1 (Table 8: Exterior open spaces / setbacks in percentage of width/depth of plot, and Table 9: All-around setbacks for buildings above 11.5 m height) of the RMP 2015 Zoning Regulations, superseding Tables 4 and 5 of the 2003 Bye-laws.

new_nodes.heading: High-rise buildings (11.5 m height and above)
new_nodes.content: In the case of high-rise buildings (11.5 m height and above), the minimum all-around front, rear, and side setbacks shall be as specified in Chapter 3, Regulation 3.1, Table 9 of the Revised Master Plan 2015 Zoning Regulations (effective 25-06-2007), starting at 5.0 m all-around for buildings above 11.5 m up to 15.0 m height and increasing progressively up to 16.0 m for buildings above 50.0 m height.

new_nodes.heading: Limitations of floor area and covered area
new_nodes.content: Under Revised Master Plan 2015 Volume III Zoning Regulations (effective 25-06-2007), the Local Planning Area of Bengaluru is organized into three main Rings (Ring I: Core Area within Core Ring Road; Ring II: Developed Area between Core Ring Road and Outer Ring Road; Ring III: Developing Area beyond Outer Ring Road) and zone-specific land-use categories in Chapter 4 (Tables 10–19), which govern maximum plot coverage and Floor Area Ratio (FAR) with reference to plot size and existing road width, superseding the 1995 CDP A, B and C areas and Table 6 of the 2003 Bye-laws.

new_nodes.heading: Parking space
new_nodes.content: Adequate space for the parking of vehicles shall be provided in the sites in accordance with the parking norms and stipulations set out in Chapter 8, Table 23 of the Revised Master Plan 2015 Volume III Zoning Regulations (effective 25-06-2007), superseding Table 13 of the 2003 Bye-laws.

new_nodes.heading: SAFETY MEASURES AGAINST EARTHQUAKE IN BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
new_nodes.content: Buildings with ground plus three floors and above or height of 11.5 m / 15.0 m and above shall be designed and constructed in accordance with the Indian Standard codes for earthquake-resistant design (IS 1893, IS 13920, IS 4326) and certified by a Registered Structural Engineer under Clause 30.0 and Chapter 9, Clause 9.3 of the RMP 2015 Zoning Regulations.

new_nodes.heading: Mutatis mutandis application of Master Plan and Zonal Regulations
new_nodes.content: Pursuant to Clause 1(3) of Notification No. UDD 14 TTP 2017 (P-4) dated 28-10-2017 (published on the official GBA/BBMP Building Plan Approval System under Bye laws and Zoning Regulations), all mandatory Master Plan or Zonal Regulations regarding use, land use, coverage, FAR, setback or open space, height, number of stories, number of dwelling units, and parking standards for various categories of buildings, including all amendments or modifications made therein from time to time, apply mutatis mutandis as part of these Bye-laws.

new_nodes.heading: 3.16(ix) Metro Station 150m Buffer FAR
new_nodes.content: Areas which fall within a distance of 150m from the outer boundary of the Metro Terminal/Station are eligible for maximum FAR of 4.0 for all permissible uses irrespective of the applicable FAR in the respective Zonal Regulations, subject to road width of minimum 18m.

new_nodes.heading: Regulations
new_nodes.content: Permissible land uses in Traffic and Transportation (T&T) zone: Main land use category T-4; Ancillary uses (Retail shops, restaurants, banks, post offices, offices, hotels, transport terminals, bus stands, railway/metro stations, multi-level parking) up to 50% of total built-up area. Table 19 (FAR and Ground Coverage in T&T Zone): Plot area up to 500 sq.m (45% coverage, 1.00 FAR up to 12m road); 500–2000 sq.m (45% coverage, 1.50 FAR on 12m–18m road); 2000–4000 sq.m (45% coverage, 1.75 FAR on 18m–24m road); above 4000 sq.m (45% coverage, 2.25 FAR on road above 24m).

new_nodes.heading: Table 1
new_nodes.content: Permissible land use in Residential category (substituted by Notification No. UDD 105 MNJ 2008 dated 20-03-2015): R-1 Plotted residential developments; R-2 Villas, semi-detached houses; R-3 Apartments, Hostels, Dharmashala; R-4 Multi-Dwelling Housing, Service Apartments; R-5 Group Housing (Development Plans); R-6 Bus bays, Auto stand, milk booth, HOPCOMS; R-7 Kalyana Mantapas; R-8 Multi-level car parking as part of residential developments.

new_nodes.heading: Regulations (Permissible land uses in Residential Main, substituted 20-03-2015)
new_nodes.content: (1) No commercial activity of whatsoever nature shall be allowed in Residential Main and Residential Mixed zones in all three rings if the road width is less than 40 ft (12 m). (2) In Ring I and II: Main land use R; Ancillary land use up to 20% of total built-up area or 50 sq.m whichever is lower on roads 40 ft (12 m) and above, only as part of residential building. (3) In Ring III: Ancillary land use up to 20% of built-up area or 50 sq.m whichever is lower.

new_nodes.heading: Regulations (Permissible land uses in Residential Mixed, substituted 20-03-2015)
new_nodes.content: In Ring I and II, ancillary commercial uses up to C-2 category permitted on roads of width 40 ft (12 m) and above subject to plot size not exceeding 1000 sq.m and space standards in Table 7; in Ring III, ancillary uses permitted up to 30% of built-up area on roads 12 m and above.

new_nodes.heading: FAR or Floor Area Ratio
new_nodes.content: FAR or Floor Area Ratio (as amended 29-09-2018 by UDD 112 MNJ 2015): Inserts sub-clause (vi) Impact Zone Premium FAR: Within a 500 m wide impact zone on either side of the outer edge of the Metro Rail corridor alignment, additional Impact Zone Premium FAR up to a maximum total FAR of 4.0 is permissible for plots of minimum 1000 sq.m abutting roads of width 18 m and above, on payment of fee at 50% of Guidance Value.

new_nodes.heading: FAR or Floor Area Ratio
new_nodes.content: FAR or Floor Area Ratio (substituted 19-06-2019 by UDD 255 MNJ 2018): Exclusions from FAR computation: (i) electrical substation/transformer/generator room; (ii) refuge areas in high-rise buildings as per fire norms; (iii) separate public toilet block in non-residential buildings on plots > 1000 sq.m; (iv) swimming pool (open to sky); (v) staircase/staircase room; (vi) architectural features; (vii) chimneys; (viii) ventilation ducts and garbage shafts; (ix) service ducts; (x) parking areas including driveways and ramps; (xi) open courts; (xii) overhead tanks; (xiii) escalators; (xiv) lift wells and lift machine room; (xv) watchman cubicle not exceeding 4 sq.m; (xvi) sewage treatment plant. Inserts Regulation 3.4-A Height of Building (NOC from HAL/AAI/Defence authorities).

new_nodes.heading: Residential Subdivision Regulations (amended 19-06-2019 by UDD 255 MNJ 2018)
new_nodes.content: In Regulation 6.1.2, residential area earmarking increased up to 55% of total layout area.

new_nodes.heading: Regulations for Residential Development Plan
new_nodes.content: Regulations for Residential and Non-Residential Development Plan (amended 19-06-2019 by UDD 255 MNJ 2018): In Table-20, Table-21, and Table-22, road width bands updated to "9m and up to 12m", "Above 18m up to 24m", and "Above 24m up to 30m"; in Regulation 7.2(c), the word "excluding" is substituted by "including".

new_nodes.heading: TRANSFER OF DEVELOPME NT RIGHTS (TDR)
new_nodes.content: Draft Notification No. UDD 78 MNJ 2024 (E) dated 21-02-2025 proposing insertion of Chapter 11 (Premium FAR); not applied from this draft because it has legal_status "draft" and was superseded by the final Gazette Notification dated 02-04-2025 (rmp2015-zr-amend-2025-04).

new_nodes.heading: TRANSFER OF DEVELOPME NT RIGHTS (TDR)
new_nodes.content: CHAPTER 11 — PREMIUM F.A.R GRANTED BY LEVY OF PREMIUM CHARGES (Inserted after Chapter 10 by Notification No. UDD 78 MNJ 2024 (E), dated 02-04-2025): (1) Additional Premium FAR over and above the permissible FAR in the Zonal Regulations is permissible based on abutting road width: (a) Road width above 9 meters and up to 12 meters: up to 20% of permissible FAR (0.2 factor); (b) Road width above 12 meters and up to 18 meters: up to 40% of permissible FAR (0.4 factor); (c) Road width above 18 meters: up to 60% of permissible FAR (0.6 factor). (2) The maximum combined additional FAR (Premium FAR + TDR/DRC) shall not exceed 60% of regular permissible FAR. (3) Premium FAR charges shall be 50% of the Guidance Value (under Section 45B of the Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957) of the notional land required for the additional floor area (i.e. Additional Built-up Area divided by permissible FAR), or 28% of the combined land + building guidance value per sq.m, whichever is higher.

new_nodes.heading: Regulations
new_nodes.content: Regulations for Park and Open Space (P) & Valley / Drain Buffer Zones (amended 15-10-2025 by Notification No. UDD 468 MNJ 2025(E)): In case of water bodies, a 30.0 m buffer of "No Development Zone" is to be maintained around the lake as per revenue records. Valley / Storm Water Drain (Nala) Buffer Table: (1) Primary / Raja Kaluve (P-1): 15m buffer from the edge of the drain; (2) Secondary drain (P-2): 10m buffer from the edge of the drain; (3) Tertiary drain (P-3): 5m buffer from the edge of the drain. Drains/nalas leading to tertiary drains shall be maintained as per revenue records and no buffer shall be insisted for such drains.

new_nodes.heading: SETBACKS (substituted 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E))
new_nodes.content: Clauses (ii) & (iii) and Table 8 (Setbacks for buildings with total height up to 12.0 m excluding stilt floor): (1) Plot up to 60 sq.m (All uses): Front 0.75 m, Rear 0 m, Left 0 m, Right 0.75 m; (2) Plot above 60 sq.m up to 150 sq.m (Width up to 9.0 m): Front 0.90 m, Rear 0.75 m, Left 0.75 m, Right 0.90 m; (Width above 9.0 m): Front 12% of depth (min 1.0 m), Rear 8% (min 0.75 m), Left 8% (min 0.75 m), Right 8% (min 1.0 m); (3) Plot above 150 sq.m up to 250 sq.m: Front 1.00 m (or 12%), Rear 0.80 m (or 8%), Left 0.80 m (or 8%), Right 1.00 m (or 8%); (4) Plot above 250 sq.m up to 4000 sq.m: Front 12% of depth, Rear 8% of depth, Left 8% of width, Right 8% of width; (5) Plot above 4000 sq.m: minimum setback of 5.0 m on all sides. new_nodes.heading: MUTATION CORRIDORS
new_nodes.content: MUTATION CORRIDORS (Table 15 substituted 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): (1) Plot size up to 10000 sq.m: Max Ground Coverage 55%; FAR 2.75 on roads up to 30m, FAR 3.25 on roads above 30m; (2) Plot size above 10000 sq.m: Max Ground Coverage 50%; FAR 3.25 on all roads.

new_nodes.heading: INDUSTRIAL [I (General)]
new_nodes.content: INDUSTRIAL I (GENERAL) (Table 16 substituted 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): (1) Tiny (up to 500 sq.m): 75% coverage, 1.50 FAR, min road width up to 9m; (2) Small (above 500 up to 2000 sq.m): 65% coverage, 1.50 FAR, min road above 9m; (3) Medium (above 2000 up to 4000 sq.m): 55% coverage, 1.25 FAR, min road above 12m; (4) Large (above 4000 sq.m): 50% coverage, 1.25 FAR, min road above 12m.

links.note: 3.16(ix) Metro Station 150m Buffer FAR: Areas which fall within a distance of 150m from the outer boundary of the Metro Terminal/Station are eligible for maximum FAR of 4.0 for all permissible uses irrespective of the applicable FAR in the respective Zonal Regulations, subject to road width of minimum 18m.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 93 MNJ 2008 dated 02-03-2009 inserts clause (ix) under Regulation 3.16 (General notes) granting FAR 4.0 within 150m of Metro Rail stations.

links.note: 4.10.2 Regulations: Permissible land uses in Traffic and Transportation (T&T) zone: Main land use category T-4; Ancillary uses (Retail shops, restaurants, banks, post offices, offices, hotels, transport terminals, bus stands, railway/metro stations, multi-level parking) up to 50% of total built-up area. Table 19 (FAR and Ground Coverage in T&T Zone): Plot area up to 500 sq.m (45% coverage, 1.00 FAR up to 12m road); 500–2000 sq.m (45% coverage, 1.50 FAR on 12m–18m road); 2000–4000 sq.m (45% coverage, 1.75 FAR on 18m–24m road); above 4000 sq.m (45% coverage, 2.25 FAR on road above 24m).
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 93 MNJ 2008 dated 02-03-2009 substitutes Regulation 4.10.2 and Table 19 (FAR and Ground Coverage in Traffic and Transportation zone).

links.note: Table 1: Permissible land use in Residential category (substituted by Notification No. UDD 105 MNJ 2008 dated 20-03-2015): R-1 Plotted residential developments; R-2 Villas, semi-detached houses; R-3 Apartments, Hostels, Dharmashala; R-4 Multi-Dwelling Housing, Service Apartments; R-5 Group Housing (Development Plans); R-6 Bus bays, Auto stand, milk booth, HOPCOMS; R-7 Kalyana Mantapas; R-8 Multi-level car parking as part of residential developments.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 105 MNJ 2008 dated 20-03-2015 substitutes Table 1 (Permissible land use in Residential category).

links.note: 4.1.2 Regulations (Permissible land uses in Residential Main, substituted 20-03-2015): (1) No commercial activity of whatsoever nature shall be allowed in Residential Main and Residential Mixed zones in all three rings if the road width is less than 40 ft (12 m). (2) In Ring I and II: Main land use R; Ancillary land use up to 20% of total built-up area or 50 sq.m whichever is lower on roads 40 ft (12 m) and above, only as part of residential building. (3) In Ring III: Ancillary land use up to 20% of built-up area or 50 sq.m whichever is lower.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 105 MNJ 2008 dated 20-03-2015 substitutes Regulation 4.1.2 (Permissible land uses in Residential Main across Rings I, II & III).

links.note: 4.2.2 Regulations (Permissible land uses in Residential Mixed, substituted 20-03-2015): In Ring I and II, ancillary commercial uses up to C-2 category permitted on roads of width 40 ft (12 m) and above subject to plot size not exceeding 1000 sq.m and space standards in Table 7; in Ring III, ancillary uses permitted up to 30% of built-up area on roads 12 m and above.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 105 MNJ 2008 dated 20-03-2015 substitutes Regulation 4.2.2 (Permissible land uses in Residential Mixed across Rings I, II & III).

links.note: 3.4 FAR or Floor Area Ratio (as amended 29-09-2018 by UDD 112 MNJ 2015): Inserts sub-clause (vi) Impact Zone Premium FAR: Within a 500 m wide impact zone on either side of the outer edge of the Metro Rail corridor alignment, additional Impact Zone Premium FAR up to a maximum total FAR of 4.0 is permissible for plots of minimum 1000 sq.m abutting roads of width 18 m and above, on payment of fee at 50% of Guidance Value.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 112 MNJ 2015 dated 29-09-2018 inserts sub-clause 3.4(vi) Impact Zone Premium FAR (500m Metro corridor buffer, up to FAR 4.0) and Appendix-IX.

links.note: 3.4 FAR or Floor Area Ratio (substituted 19-06-2019 by UDD 255 MNJ 2018): Exclusions from FAR computation: (i) electrical substation/transformer/generator room; (ii) refuge areas in high-rise buildings as per fire norms; (iii) separate public toilet block in non-residential buildings on plots > 1000 sq.m; (iv) swimming pool (open to sky); (v) staircase/staircase room; (vi) architectural features; (vii) chimneys; (viii) ventilation ducts and garbage shafts; (ix) service ducts; (x) parking areas including driveways and ramps; (xi) open courts; (xii) overhead tanks; (xiii) escalators; (xiv) lift wells and lift machine room; (xv) watchman cubicle not exceeding 4 sq.m; (xvi) sewage treatment plant. Inserts Regulation 3.4-A Height of Building (NOC from HAL/AAI/Defence authorities).
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 255 MNJ 2018 dated 19-06-2019 substitutes Regulation 3.4 FAR exclusions (i)–(xvi) and inserts Regulation 3.4-A Height of Building.

links.note: 11.0 CHAPTER 11 — PREMIUM F.A.R GRANTED BY LEVY OF PREMIUM CHARGES (Inserted after Chapter 10 by Notification No. UDD 78 MNJ 2024 (E), dated 02-04-2025): (1) Additional Premium FAR over and above the permissible FAR in the Zonal Regulations is permissible based on abutting road width: (a) Road width above 9 meters and up to 12 meters: up to 20% of permissible FAR (0.2 factor); (b) Road width above 12 meters and up to 18 meters: up to 40% of permissible FAR (0.4 factor); (c) Road width above 18 meters: up to 60% of permissible FAR (0.6 factor). (2) The maximum combined additional FAR (Premium FAR + TDR/DRC) shall not exceed 60% of regular permissible FAR. (3) Premium FAR charges shall be 50% of the Guidance Value (under Section 45B of the Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957) of the notional land required for the additional floor area (i.e. Additional Built-up Area divided by permissible FAR), or 28% of the combined land + building guidance value per sq.m, whichever is higher.
links.summary: Final Notification No. UDD 78 MNJ 2024 (E) dated 02-04-2025 inserts Chapter 11 (Premium F.A.R Granted by Levy of Premium Charges) after Chapter 10 of RMP 2015 Zonal Regulations.

links.note: 4.12.2 Regulations for Park and Open Space (P) & Valley / Drain Buffer Zones (amended 15-10-2025 by Notification No. UDD 468 MNJ 2025(E)): In case of water bodies, a 30.0 m buffer of "No Development Zone" is to be maintained around the lake as per revenue records. Valley / Storm Water Drain (Nala) Buffer Table: (1) Primary / Raja Kaluve (P-1): 15m buffer from the edge of the drain; (2) Secondary drain (P-2): 10m buffer from the edge of the drain; (3) Tertiary drain (P-3): 5m buffer from the edge of the drain. Drains/nalas leading to tertiary drains shall be maintained as per revenue records and no buffer shall be insisted for such drains.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 468 MNJ 2025(E) dated 15-10-2025 substitutes the storm water drain / nala buffer table under Regulation 4.12.2 (Primary 15m, Secondary 10m, Tertiary 5m).

links.note: 3.1 SETBACKS (substituted 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): Clauses (ii) & (iii) and Table 8 (Setbacks for buildings with total height up to 12.0 m excluding stilt floor): (1) Plot up to 60 sq.m (All uses): Front 0.75 m, Rear 0 m, Left 0 m, Right 0.75 m; (2) Plot above 60 sq.m up to 150 sq.m (Width up to 9.0 m): Front 0.90 m, Rear 0.75 m, Left 0.75 m, Right 0.90 m; (Width above 9.0 m): Front 12% of depth (min 1.0 m), Rear 8% (min 0.75 m), Left 8% (min 0.75 m), Right 8% (min 1.0 m); (3) Plot above 150 sq.m up to 250 sq.m: Front 1.00 m (or 12%), Rear 0.80 m (or 8%), Left 0.80 m (or 8%), Right 1.00 m (or 8%); (4) Plot above 250 sq.m up to 4000 sq.m: Front 12% of depth, Rear 8% of depth, Left 8% of width, Right 8% of width; (5) Plot above 4000 sq.m: minimum setback of 5.0 m on all sides. Note 1: For plots up to 250 sq.m in area, maximum permissible building height is 15.0 m (including stilt floor) and setbacks in Table 8 apply.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E) dated 05-01-2026 substitutes Regulation 3.1 Clauses (ii)–(iii), Table 8 (Setbacks up to 12m/15m height), and inserts Notes 1–7 after Table 9.

links.note: 3.9 Basement (amended 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): (iii) One basement (single cellar) is permitted for residential buildings on plot area above 200 sq.m abutting road width above 9.0 m solely for parking and household services; (x) Vehicle parking in basement or upper floors may use mechanical/automated multi-level parking systems.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E) dated 05-01-2026 amends Regulation 3.9 Basement clauses (iii) and (x).

links.note: 3.10 Ramps (amended 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): (i) Minimum ramp width 1.5 m for two-wheelers; (iii) For plot area up to 1000 sq.m, a single ramp of 3.5 m width is permitted with 1.0 m setback from plot boundary; (x) For plot area up to 500 sq.m, mechanical/hydraulic car lift is permitted without ramps.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E) dated 05-01-2026 amends Regulation 3.10 Ramps clauses (i), (iii), (iv), and (x).

links.note: 4.5 MUTATION CORRIDORS (Table 15 substituted 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): (1) Plot size up to 10000 sq.m: Max Ground Coverage 55%; FAR 2.75 on roads up to 30m, FAR 3.25 on roads above 30m; (2) Plot size above 10000 sq.m: Max Ground Coverage 50%; FAR 3.25 on all roads.
links.summary: Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E) dated 05-01-2026 substitutes Table 15 under Regulation 4.5 (Mutation Corridors).

links.note: 4.7 INDUSTRIAL I (GENERAL) (Table 16 substituted 05-01-2026 by Notification No. UDD 235 MNJ 2025(E)): (1) Tiny (up to 500 sq.m): 75% coverage, 1.50 FAR, min road width up to 9m; (2) Small (above 500 up to 2000 sq.m): 65% coverage, 1.50 FAR, min road above 9m; (3) Medium (above 2000 up to 4000 sq.m): 55% coverage, 1.25 FAR, min road above 12m; (4) Large (above 4000 sq.m): 50% coverage, 1.25 FAR, min road above 12m.
